note: TARGET IS MODELLED/PREDICTED YIELD (predicted_Yield_2022/2023 from the Yield_with_clustering GPKGs), NOT measured yield. This is not a real yield-accuracy result, it demonstrates how much of the apparent fit is circular reconstruction of the clustering model's own generating formula. See project convention: predicted_Yield is a modelled value, never ground truth.

measured_yield_model_for_comparison.note: from section 22/25, the real, honest, non-circular result

decomposition_where_does_the_R2_actually.note: n=1530 (all Plot-A trees with physiology+EBI+predicted_Yield in either year, not just the 167 measured-yield trees), same haversine-free direct GPKG match.
decomposition_where_does_the_R2_actually.interpretation: Almost all of setting B's 0.8238 comes from cultivar+climate alone (0.8215), i.e. which year and which cultivar a tree belongs to. Since only 2 distinct years are pooled, climate is itself a year indicator (section 25), so this says predicted_Yield jumps hugely between 2022 and 2023 by cultivar, and EBI adds essentially nothing on top (+0.002, negligible): EBI alone explains ~2% and adding it to cultivar+climate barely moves the number. This is a clarifying result, not a discouraging one: EBI's real, modest relationship with MEASURED yield (r=+0.137 pooled, cultivar-dependent reversal, sections 11-12) is not an artifact of leaking through the circular predicted_Yield pipeline, predicted_Yield barely responds to EBI at all. The only channel that inflates R^2 toward 0.94 is the direct physiology fields (setting C), which are literal inputs to the RF Yield model's own formula (section 24), so that inflation is mechanical circularity, not predictive skill.
